login.heroBadge: Client and attorney in one workflow
login.heroTitle: Recover financial clarity before making an important decision.
login.heroBody: Organize income, expenses, debts, assets, and evidence in one guided experience. Then share a structured case file with the attorney who will review your case.
login.title: Access the portal
login.subtitle: Sign in with your credentials, or enter a seeded demo session in one click.
login.clientHint: Opens the client workspace with synthetic demo data.
login.attorneyHint: Opens the attorney dashboard and case inbox with the seeded review case.
login.demoAccessHint: These buttons use the real sign-in flow with seeded accounts. No password entry needed.
login.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Contact the demo team.
login.disclaimer: Fresh Start organizes information for a consultation. It does not replace legal review or legal advice. These demo credentials are public and shared by every visitor — never enter real personal or financial information.
